text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's finally, finally here—!
The Arima Kinen~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, Trainer-chan.
Keep your eyes on me, okay? In this race, Maya's gonna—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ha! To think I'd be crossing swords with you again this year.
...Have you washed your neck ready for the blade?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I haven't the faintest idea
what you're trying to say, Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aah?! What I just said was referencing
when I told you last year to 'wash your neck and wait'—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I didn't ask you
to explain your reasoning.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You understand, don't you?
If you want to pick a fight with me—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't use words, use the race.
Come at me with the serious intent to take my head.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then let's have a duel.
At the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh... That's a good look in your eyes.

—The ones standing at the end of Mayano Top Gun's gaze
were the "Triple Crown Umamusume" Narita Brian
and the "Amazoness" Hishi Amazon—those two.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry, Trainer-chan!
Guess I spaced out for a second!
choice_data_list: Seeing it again, it really has a different impact.
Seeing it again, it really has a different impact, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no no nooo! Don't say it!
Maya isn't gonna lose either!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So during the race too, don't you dare take your eyes off Maya, okay?
Promise me, okay~?
